As per routine, the bidding process was divided in two parts i.e. determining the technical responsiveness, followed by the assessment of the financial bids. In terms of the conditions of the RFP, the bidding was, subject to certain conditions, also open to persons from countries other than India; one of the primary conditions for the same being approval of the Competent Authority from national security and public interest perspective, as per the applicable instructions of the Government of India, in terms of clause 2.1.12(a) of the RFP.
